summary: Configures an audio buffer format on the audio sub-object. Guards on a configuration object (a3 non-zero with a non-zero dword at a3+32). Optionally tears down a pending buffer via vtable slot 148 on the sub-object at this[1088] (this+0x1100), then enters a state 7 via vtable slot 200. Decodes format flags from a7/a8 into the channel-config field this[1116] (this+0x1170) with 256/1280/2304 base values and 1/0x800 flag bits, dispatches through sub_554790, the multi-field setter, the chained state init and the property setter, then invokes vtable slot 280 (format set) with either a buffered or a divided sample rate, restoring the saved state field this[1262] (this+0x13B8) through a final vtable slot 200 call. Called by sub_553070 (00553070) and sub_553700 (00553700).

local_names.this: audio configuration object holding the sub-object pointer and channel/state fields
local_names.a3: configuration object whose presence gates the whole block
local_names.a4: sample-rate related argument passed to the format-set vtable slot
local_names.a5: sample-rate related argument divided by 3 when a10 is not set
local_names.a6: format option controlling the a6-present branch and validation
local_names.a7: byte flag set selecting channel/config variants (0x20, 0x40)
local_names.a8: word flag set selecting bit-depth/format variants (0x1400/0x2800 masks, 0x80)
local_names.a10: presence flag choosing between buffered and /3 sample-rate format-set calls
local_names.v12: local mode tag passed to sub_554790 (65538, 393221 or 327686)
local_names.v16: result of the format-set vtable call
local_names.v17: saved state field this[1262] (this+0x13B8) restored through the final vtable call
local_names.v19: local flag set to 4 (a6 branch) or 0 (a6-absent branch)
local_names.v20: local flag set to 3 or 2 on certain format bits
local_names.v22: decoded value from a8 & 0x1400 (1 for 1024, 2 for 4096)
local_names.v23: decoded value from a8 & 0x2800 (1 for 2048, 2 for 0x2000)

operations.description: StructInitWithDefaultValues initializes the local 32-byte structure v18 to defaults
The whole configuration block runs only when a3 is non-zero and the dword at a3+32 is non-zero; otherwise the function returns the incoming a3 value

When the pending-init flag this[1267] (this+0x13CC) is set, the flag is cleared and vtable slot 148 on the sub-object at this[1088] is invoked with (256, this+1283) to tear down the prior buffer, storing the result at this+0x0
vtable slot 200 on the sub-object at this[1088] (this+0x1100) is invoked with (7, 0) to enter state 7, storing the result at this+0x0
a6-present branch: sub_554F80(a2, a6) validates the format and early-returns its result when it is 0
Decodes a8 & 0x1400: v22 is set to 1 when the masked value equals 1024, or 2 when it equals 4096
Decodes a8 & 0x2800: v23 is set to 1 when the masked value equals 2048, or 2 when it equals 0x2000

Channel/config field this[1116] (this+0x1170) is set to 256 as the base value; a7 & 0x40 overrides it to 1280; a8 & 0x80 ORs in 1 and sets v20 to 3; a7 & 0x20 ORs in 0x800, sets v20 to 2 and v12 to 393221
a6-absent branch: this[1116] (this+0x1170) is set to 256 with v19 cleared, or to 2304 with v20 2 and v12 327686 when a7 & 0x20 is set
sub_554790(this[1116], v12, a9) dispatches the chosen channel configuration with its mode tag
MultiFieldSetterDispatchingTo7SubSetters(v18, 0) pushes the initialized local structure through seven sub-setters
StateFieldSetWithChainedInit(1) sets a state field with chained initialization
PropertyValueSetterWithRefreshOnChange(a3) applies the configuration object through a refresh-on-change property setter
vtable slot 280 on the sub-object at this[1088] (this+0x1100) sets the format: with a10 set it is called as (6, a4, a10); otherwise as (4, a4, a5 / 3)

The saved state field this[1262] (this+0x13B8) is read into v17, the format-set result is stored at this+0x0, then vtable slot 200 is re-invoked with (7, v17) to restore the state and its result is stored at this+0x0
Returns the result of the last operation, which is a3 when the config guard failed
Invoked by sub_553070 (00553070) and sub_553700 (00553700) to configure the audio buffer format
